items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was a drummer that when you turned your back his name was Arnold Bolen, 'Scrippy'

ctx.x: Kaiser was playing in Chick's band?

Yes. He was listening to the band and he said, "No, Kaiser, not with my band." At that particular time I was almost tempted to leave Basie's band to join Chick Webb's band because of his kidney ailment. I was going to leave Basie's band and play with Mr. Chick Webb out of respect and out of love and at the same time I had a selfish motive. I realized that this man was dying and there were several drummers in New York that never took advantage of being around Mr. Chick Webb and they had been in New York and been…
